question_text:
Although strict vigilance by the police has brought down the rate of night crimes, daylight
robberies and chain-snatching etc have only increased.
Courses of action:
(I)
The police should be asked to stop its vigilance programme during nights.
(II)
The police should be given powers to kill criminals involved in daylight robberies and
chain-snatching.
(III) The police should be directed to reorient its strategy so that daylight crimes are not
ignored.
